body:
Mina: Ready to enable orbit-v2-13b in catalog for a staged rollout at 23:00 UTC today. Proposal for fallback ladder: orbit-v1 -> comet-13b-quant -> default-13b.

Jonathan: Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC sounds good. Any infra clashes?

Alex: No infra migrations. We should pin EU traffic keys during early ramp to avoid cross-region model swaps.

Mina: @DeployBot create rollout for model=orbit-v2-13b env=prod window=2026-03-20T23:00Z-2026-03-21T01:00Z canary=5%

DeployBot: Rollout created: id=r-20260320-01. Status: scheduled. Link: https://deploy.redwood.internal/r/r-20260320-01

SRE-OnCall: Please confirm alert burn-in thresholds. Suggest: latency increase >15% (5m) -> auto-rollback; error rate >3% (5m) -> auto-rollback.

Jonathan: Ack. Adding token-cost regression monitor too (alert if +25% cost/token sustained 10m).

Mina: Draft release notes: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/orbit-v2-13b.md —calling out minor sampling/repetition differences and recommended prompt tweak.

Dana: Quick preflight: we'll run a 1k-sample smoke in staging. Alex, can you kick it?

Alex: Running now. Quick log snippet: ```staging-smoke 1000/1000 passed; p95 latency 180ms; errors 0```

DeployBot: Canary started: r-20260320-01 -> traffic 5% at 23:05 UTC.

Mina: Observability: first 10m looks clean (no errors, latency within baseline). Proposal: keep canary at 5% for 30m, then ramp to 25% if no regressions.

SRE-OnCall: Added rollback triggers in monitoring: errors >5% OR latency >20% OR cost per token +30% => immediate rollback. Also added pager escalation to oncall if triggered.

Jonathan: Pin list updated: eu-west-1 pinned to orbit-v1 for 1h to reduce risk of region-flap during ramp.

Dana: Note for release notes: document pinned variants + fallback ladder + customer-facing risk summary.

Mina: Rollback plan reminder: if trigger fires -> pin traffic back to orbit-v1, abort rollout r-20260320-01, post status page update, run 30m triage call and follow-up postmortem.

DeployBot: Canary passed 30m health checks. Ramping to 25% at 23:40 UTC.

Alex: Ramp progressed: 25% -> no anomalies observed. Telemetry: p95 latency +3%, error ~0.4%.

Mina: Final ramp scheduled at 00:10 UTC: bursts 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m, with 10m observation windows between bursts.

SRE-OnCall: I'll be on watch and will escalate on any threshold breach. Tagged @oncall.

Jonathan: LGTM. Good luck :rocket:

Mina: Thanks team. I'll post a short roll-forward summary once at steady-state and update the release notes with observed perf numbers.

Alex: one follow-up: adding a fast-fallback script in ops toolbox: `ops rollback --rollout r-20260320-01 --pin orbit-v1` so oncall can execute quickly.

Dana: Copy — storing command in runbook.

Mina: Closing thread, monitoring active.
